  (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) 
  (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) : 
  α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) :=
{
  toFun := λ a => ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  , invFun := λ y => f_inv (nonempty_of_exists y.2) y.1
  , left_inv := λ a => hf (nonempty_of_exists (Set.mem_range_self a)) a
  , right_inv := λ y => 
    let b := y.1
    let h_mem := y.2
    let h_nonempty := nonempty_of_exists h_mem

      let rec aux : ∀ (h_mem : ∃ a, f a = b), f (g b) = b

        rw [this] at this
        exact this
      in aux h_mem
    Subtype.eq H
}
